items.headline: MIT CSAIL says GPT-6 Astra edited Qwen weights, lifting MATH-500 from 7.9% to 48.1%
items.excerpt: MIT CSAIL researchers reported on 2 November that GPT-6 Astra edited 0.016% of Qwen3.5-0.8B's weights by reasoning about them in natural language, lifting the model's MATH-500 score from 7.9% to 48.1%.

items.headline: Meituan released LongCat-2.5, a 1.6 trillion parameter multimodal model for agentic coding
items.excerpt: Meituan released LongCat-2.5 on 2 November, a 1.6 trillion parameter multimodal model with about 48 billion active parameters per token, built for long-horizon agentic coding.

items.headline: DeepSeek released Super-agent, an open-source coding agent that reads developer group chats
items.excerpt: DeepSeek's Harness team released Super-agent on 31 October, an open-source research prototype of a coding agent that reads developer group chats and email and proposes fixes on its own.

items.headline: Xiaomi open-sourced Xiaomi-OCR-0, a 0.8B document model scoring 96.83 on OmniDocBench
items.excerpt: Xiaomi open-sourced Xiaomi-OCR-0 on 30 October, a 0.8-billion-parameter document model that Xiaomi reports scores 96.83 on OmniDocBench v1.6, the highest of any model under 1 billion parameters.

items.headline: Anthropic renamed Max 20x to Ultra and lifted its 5-hour limit for verified accounts
items.excerpt: Anthropic renamed its Max 20x plan to Ultra on 30 October, kept the price at $200 a month, and removed the 5-hour usage limit for verified Ultra accounts.

items.headline: DiffuSpace open-sourced Clover, a diffusion coding model reporting 73.6 on SWE-bench Verified
items.excerpt: DiffuSpace released open weights for Clover-35B-A3B-Preview on 29 October, a diffusion language model that the team says scores 73.6 on SWE-bench Verified.
